description: FREE lite GEO readiness audit of a brand/storefront URL. Runs the same 20 checks as audit_geo but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — no per-check evidence, no detailed recommendations. Use this to triage whether a site needs the full audit_geo report, or call audit_geo directly for the complete evidence-backed audit.

url.description: Brand/storefront URL to audit, e.g. https://example-brand.com

name: audit_geo_lite
